items.t: Bloom Energy Tumbles 11% Despite Morgan Stanley Reiterating $335 Target; FuelCell Energy Drops 7%, Plug Power Falls 6%
items.sum: Wall Street’s most bullish calls aren’t slowing the selling in fuel cell stocks as the AI trade cracks again. Bloom Energy (NYSE:BE) stock is sliding $138.96 in morning trading, down 11%. That slip still leaves the stock up 60% year to date (YTD), a reminder of how far Bloom Energy ran before the AI trade […]

items.t: FuelCell Energy Tumbles 10%, Bloom Energy Sinks 8% as Monday’s AI Power Rally Fades; Plug Power Drops 5%
items.sum: One company's balance sheet is swelling with profit while another is leaning on its cash pile, yet all three fuel-cell stocks are sliding together. What separates the AI power winner from the names still waiting for proof?

items.t: Tradr to Launch Six New Leveraged ETFs
items.sum: Tradr ETFs, a provider of ETFs designed for sophisticated investors and professional traders, expects to launch six new leveraged ETFs on December 2, 2026, all to be listed on Cboe. The launches include three funds in Tradr's new Triple Threat series and three first-to-market single-stock ETFs.

items.t: Bloom Energy is Down 22% Just This Month: Two Wall Street Pros Predict 109% Gains With 2 More $1 Dollar Lower
items.sum: Bloom Energy posted a beat-and-raise quarter, yet its shares have lost roughly half their value from the peak. Two analysts still hold the Street-high target, and the fuel cell peers fared even worse. What does the market see that the guidance misses?

items.t: Fluence Energy, Inc. (FLNC) Reports Q4 Loss, Misses Revenue Estimates
